about: The ideal carrier. Vectors whose expected values are written by hand,
not taken from either head. The entry condition of BEP-0005.
L0 is the law the set-algebra bank does not state: U is an up-set, D is
a down-set. Without it, L1–L9 pass on arbitrary subsets of Omega.

coverage.criterion: a non-closed set is refused, and a closed pair is kept
coverage.why: the falsifier that replaces M3 once conservation is unconditional

cases.name: closure-rejects-a-non-ideal
cases.why: demand {x} is not an up-set (both is above x); permit {y} is not a down-set (none is below y)
